summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (press release) announcing that its Luxembourg subsidiary signed an agreement to acquire 100% of a project company holding a ready-to-build 51.75 MW/207 MWh battery storage project in northern Italy, marking its entry into the Italian storage market. Terms: 100% share acquisition; no price, premium, or value disclosed. Board recommendation: management expressed enthusiasm. Conditions precedent with a deadline by end of 2027. Structural note: first Italian BESS project; acquisition via wholly owned subsidiary; regulatory and permitting conditions likely. What to watch: satisfaction of conditions precedent; timeline risk; potential future Italian storage opportunities.
